title: handled tote bags
text: handled tote bags. These are really just OK.  They are cloth, and have handles.  But they are pretty lightweight and don't stay open (like shown in the picture) unless they have something in them to keep them open.  The colors and pattern do match the photos shown.  They did not work for what I purchased them for, so I donated them.
